title: What type of monster am I?
excerpt: For a laugh I asked ChatGPT 'based on everything you know about me create an original monster that based on my personality and character.' Here are the results!
content:
For a laugh I asked ChatGPT 

>based on everything you know about me create an original monster that based on my personality and character.

Here are the results

### The Dreamweaver

![The Dreamweaver](/static-data/images/558f4961-59db-4934-822b-243c4e77fa26.png)

**The Dreamweaver is a guardian, adventurer and thinker — a creature built around the idea that strength isn't just about being tough. It's about continuing to grow, protecting the people you care about, and being comfortable enough with yourself to keep changing.**

### Core characteristics

- **Loyal** — Once someone matters to the Dreamweaver, they matter deeply. It doesn't abandon the people it cares about.
- **Protective** — It instinctively wants to help and protect others, particularly the people closest to it.
- **Resilient** — It's been through difficult periods but doesn't see setbacks as the end of the story. They become part of the process of growing.
- **Passionate** — When something matters, it commits to it. Whether that's people, work, dreams or personal goals, it doesn't really do things half-heartedly.
- **Adventurous** — It wants new experiences, new places and new challenges. Staying exactly where it is forever isn't enough.
- **A deep thinker** — The Dreamweaver's greatest strength can also be its weakness. It thinks, analyses and sometimes overthinks, but that also means it notices things other people might miss.
- **Independent** — It doesn't want someone else permanently telling it what to do. Ultimately, it wants to make its own decisions and find its own path.
- **Always evolving** — The Dreamweaver isn't a finished creature. It's constantly trying to become a better version of itself.

### Its special abilities

**Dream Manipulation**  
The ability to imagine different possibilities and turn ideas into something real. This represents ambition, creativity and the tendency to think about what *could* be rather than simply accepting what already exists.

**Shadow Travel**  
The ability to move through difficult or uncertain situations while still finding a way forward. Sometimes the path isn't obvious, but that doesn't mean there isn't one.

**Enhanced Senses**  
The Dreamweaver notices things. It picks up on people's emotions, details and inconsistencies and tends to think about what's happening beneath the surface.

**Healing Touch**  
Not every problem needs to be solved. Sometimes people simply need someone who will listen, understand and give them somewhere safe to land.

**Astral Form**  
The ability to step outside the immediate situation and look at the bigger picture — something particularly useful for someone who naturally spends a lot of time thinking about the past, present and future.

### What the Dreamweaver represents

The most important part of the monster isn't its wings, armour or supernatural abilities.

It's the idea that **personal growth isn't about becoming a completely different person**.

It's about taking the person you already are — strengths, weaknesses, mistakes, ambitions, insecurities and all — and gradually building something better.

The Dreamweaver is therefore a mixture of **strength and vulnerability**. It can be powerful without pretending it has everything figured out. It can protect other people while still needing support itself. It can be ambitious while recognising that progress isn't always linear.

And perhaps its defining characteristic is this:

> **It doesn't want to stop growing.**
